title: Asymptotic work of the Fourier estimator
statement: As the scale of small-bias Fourier estimation tasks tends to infinity, the estimator's work is $O((\text{scale}+1)^8)$. Here each task consists of accuracy data with positive dimension, positive numerator, and twice the numerator at most the denominator, a Fourier bound of at least $1$, and a finite coordinate set in the resulting dimension.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Task includes a finite coordinate set in the resulting dimension
Asymptotic parameter is the task's scale tending to infinity
